description.value: The Best Western Plus Kamloops Hotel is an award-winning, eco-friendly property situated on Tk'emlúps te Secwépemc territory in Kamloops, explicitly catering to cyclists with dedicated bike-friendly rooms and on-site bike storage facilities. The hotel sits within walking distance of restaurants, pubs, and groceries, and is a short ride from Kamloops' extensive mountain biking trail networks. Amenities include a heated indoor saltwater pool, complimentary breakfast, and two EV charging stations.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website content is fully accessible and detailed. The Rooms page explicitly states 'We know how important your bike is, so you can store it in your room or our bike storage facilities,' confirming secure bike storage; a dedicated 'Bike Friendly' room type is also listed. Two discrepancies noted: OSM lists the name as 'Best Western' while the website consistently uses 'Best Western Plus Kamloops Hotel,' and the OSM postal code (V2C 2V5) differs from the website's postal code (V2C 1L1).
concerns: OSM name is 'Best Western' but the website consistently uses 'Best Western Plus Kamloops Hotel' — the 'Plus' tier designation and full hotel name are absent from the OSM record.
Postal code mismatch: OSM records V2C 2V5 but the website shows V2C 1L1 — website value is likely more current; contact_confirmed.address set to false.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Active, open hotel with explicitly advertised cyclist-friendly amenities including dedicated bike storage and bike-friendly room types; clearly a real, publicly accessible business of direct relevance to touring cyclists.
